sentences.text: As a licensed captain operating commercially, you must take part in a Department of Transportation drug testing program.
Most owner-operators join a consortium that handles random testing.
Tests are required before employment, at random, after a serious marine incident, and when there’s reasonable cause.
For alcohol, a commercial vessel operator is considered intoxicated at a blood alcohol concentration of zero point zero four percent, half the recreational limit.
After a serious marine incident, alcohol testing must be done within two hours and drug testing within thirty-two hours.
Refusing a test can cost you your license.
